posts.text: Trump winning means no war. War is simply not in the cards. Anyone talking about war with Iran is just out to lunch.
Wait, so Israel going to war with Iran without us is somehow proving me wrong? Are you stupid? (yes)
So, no war with Iran, no nukes. Wake me up when that changes, I'll gladly eat my words (until then, I'm right yet again)

The whole point - the entire point - was that we would be "dying for Israel" and have "boots on the ground" in Iran. That didn't happen - that WONT happen - and yet everyone is claiming victory. You're just missing the bigger picture here.

Many of us made our voices loud and clear that we didn't want to be embroiled in a forever war in the Middle East - but it was in good faith! Many denouncing Trump and MAGA were doing so because they're personally invested in seeing the administration fail. Big difference!
Can I get a war with Iran update? You guys had all those big spaces and posts about regime change, nuclear strikes and Americans dying for Israel. Can we get an update on that
